inputs.description: mutualInformation()/mutualInformationBtwSets() over every singleton, adjacent pair and the full feature set of two boolean CTables (4-input parity, 6-input mixed), in three states: untouched (baseline), emptied by CTable::remove_rows over the whole uncompressed index range (the subsampleCTable(0.0) case), and with every count_t zeroed but the rows kept (total == 0.0 with non-empty counters). Plus OTEntropy() and the ITable/OTable mutualInformation overload on an empty table. No RNG is involved anywhere in this probe, so no seed is recorded.
